interval_years.quote: A license shall be valid for a two-year period unless revoked or suspended by the board and shall expire on the date that is two years after the date of issuance. A license may be renewed for additional two-year periods.

required.quote: The board shall renew an applicant's license if the applicant has paid the license renewal fee specified in section 4759.08 of the Revised Code and certifies to the board that the applicant has met the continuing education requirements adopted under division (A)(5) of section 4759.05 of the Revised Code.

available.quote: the board shall issue a license or limited permit to practice dietetics in accordance with Chapter 4796. of the Revised Code to an applicant if either of the following apply: (1) The applicant holds a license or permit in another state.

requirements.value: Applicant must hold a license or permit in another state, or have satisfactory work experience, government certification, or private certification as a dietitian in a state that does not issue that license, per Chapter 4796.
requirements.quote: The applicant holds a license or permit in another state. (2) The applicant has satisfactory work experience, a government certification, or a private certification as described in that chapter as a dietitian in a state that does not issue that license.

national_certification.quote: The board shall waive the requirements of divisions (A)(3), (4), and (5) of this section and any rules adopted under division (A)(6) of section 4759.05 of the Revised Code if the applicant presents satisfactory evidence to the board of current registration as a registered dietitian with the commission on dietetic registration.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violating or attempting to violate any provision of this chapter or the rules adopted by the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: violating or attempting to violate, directly or indirectly, or assisting in or abetting the violation of, or conspiring to violate, any provision of this chapter or the rules adopted by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in solicitation, advertising, or in securing a license
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making a false, fraudulent, deceptive, or misleading statement in the solicitation of or advertising for patients; in relation to the practice of dietetics; or in securing or attempting to secure any license or permit issued by the board under this chapter.

disciplinary_grounds.description: Committing fraud during the examination or in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Committing fraud during the administration of the examination for a license to practice or committing fraud, misrepresentation, or deception in applying for, renewing, or securing any license or permit issued by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to, judicial finding of guilt of, or judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for a felony
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a felony

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state, regardless of jurisdiction
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act that constitutes a felony in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt for a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor committed in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Commission of an act in the course of practice that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Commission of an act in the course of practice that constitutes a misdemeanor in this state, regardless of the jurisdiction in which the act was committed

disciplinary_grounds.description: Plea of guilty to or judicial finding of guilt for a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A plea of guilty to, a judicial finding of guilt of, or a judicial finding of eligibility for intervention in lieu of conviction for, a misdemeanor involving moral turpitude

disciplinary_grounds.description: A record of engaging in incompetent or negligent conduct in the practice of dietetics
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A record of engaging in incompetent or negligent conduct in the practice of dietetics

disciplinary_grounds.description: Departure from or failure to conform to minimal standards of care of similar practitioners
disciplinary_grounds.quote: A departure from, or failure to conform to, minimal standards of care of similar practitioners under the same or similar circumstances, whether or not actual injury to a patient is established

disciplinary_grounds.description: Obtaining money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The obtaining of, or attempting to obtain, money or anything of value by fraudulent misrepresentations in the course of practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board on a license or permit
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of the conditions of limitation placed by the board on a license or permit

disciplinary_grounds.description: Inability to practice according to acceptable standards by reason of mental or physical illness
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Inability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care by reason of mental illness or physical illness, including, physical deterioration that adversely affects cognitive, motor, or perceptive skills

disciplinary_grounds.description: Limitation, revocation, suspension, or other adverse action taken by another licensing authority for any reason other than nonpayment of fees
disciplinary_grounds.quote: the limitation, revocation, or suspension of an individual's license; acceptance of an individual's license surrender; denial of a license; refusal to renew or reinstate a license; imposition of probation; or issuance of an order of censure or other reprimand

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation, suspension, restriction, or termination of practice privileges by the US Department of Defense or Department of Veterans Affairs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: The revocation, suspension, restriction, reduction, or termination of practice privileges by the United States department of defense or department of veterans affairs

disciplinary_grounds.description: Termination or suspension from participation in Medicare or Medicaid programs
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Termination or suspension from participation in the medicare or medicaid programs by the department of health and human services or other responsible agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Impairment of ability to practice due to substance use disorder or excessive use of drugs, alcohol, or other substances
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Impairment of ability to practice according to acceptable and prevailing standards of care because of substance use disorder or excessive use or abuse of drugs, alcohol, or other substances that may impair ability to practice

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to cooperate in a board investigation, including failure to comply with a subpoena or answer truthfully
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure to cooperate in an investigation conducted by the board under division (B) of section 4759.05 of the Revised Code, including failure to comply with a subpoena or order issued by the board or failure to answer truthfully a question presented by the board

disciplinary_grounds.description: Representing that an incurable disease or condition can be permanently cured for the purpose of obtaining compensation
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Representing with the purpose of obtaining compensation or other advantage as personal gain or for any other person, that an incurable disease or injury, or other incurable condition, can be permanently cured.

definition_quote.value: "Practice of dietetics" means any of the following: (1) Nutritional assessment to determine nutritional needs and to recommend appropriate nutritional intake, including enteral and parenteral nutrition; (2) Nutritional counseling or education as components of preventive, curative, and restorative health care; (3) Development, administration, evaluation, and consultation regarding nutritional care standards.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics" means any of the following: (1) Nutritional assessment to determine nutritional needs and to recommend appropriate nutritional intake, including enteral and parenteral nutrition; (2) Nutritional counseling or education as components of preventive, curative, and restorative health care; (3) Development, administration, evaluation, and consultation regarding nutritional care standards.

license_type_structure.quote: the state medical board shall issue a license to practice dietetics to an applicant who meets all of the following requirements

provisional_license_available.quote: the board may grant a limited permit to a person who has completed the education and pre-professional requirements of divisions (A)(3) and (4) of this section and who presents evidence to the board of having applied to take the examination

provisional_license_requires_supervision.quote: A person holding a limited permit who has failed the examination shall practice only under the direct supervision of a licensed dietitian.

dietetic_technician_recognized.quote: A person who is a graduate of an associate degree program approved by the academy of nutrition and dietetics or the state medical board who is working as a dietetic technician under the supervision of a dietitian licensed under section 4759.06 of the Revised Code or registered by the commission on dietetic registration

rd_credential_accepted_in_lieu_of_state_.quote: The board shall waive the requirements of divisions (A)(3), (4), and (5) of this section and any rules adopted under division (A)(6) of section 4759.05 of the Revised Code if the applicant presents satisfactory evidence to the board of current registration as a registered dietitian with the commission on dietetic registration.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Practice of Dietetics" means the synthesis and application of dietetics as defined by state law and regulations, primarily for the provision of nutrition care services, including medical nutrition therapy

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: Nutritional assessment to determine nutritional needs and to recommend appropriate nutritional intake, including enteral and parenteral nutrition

telehealth_practice_authorized.quote: A dietitian may provide telehealth services in accordance with section 4743.09 of the Revised Code.

value: Persons licensed under Title XLVII acting within scope of their profession

exempt_professions_list.quote: Sections 4759.01 to 4759.08 of the Revised Code do not apply to any of the following

federal_employee_exemption.quote: A person who practices dietetics related to employment in the armed forces, veteran's administration, or the public health service of the United States

weight_control_program_exemption.quote: a general program of instruction for weight control approved in writing by a licensed dietitian, a physician licensed under Chapter 4731. of the Revised Code to practice medicine or surgery or osteopathic medicine or surgery, a person licensed in another state that the board considers to have substantially equivalent licensure requirements as this state, or a registered dietitian

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: the sale of food, food materials, or dietary supplements and the marketing and distribution of food, food materials, or dietary supplements and the promotion or explanation of the use of food, food materials, or dietary supplements

interstate_compact_member.quote: The dietitian licensure compact is hereby ratified, enacted into law, and entered into by the state of Ohio as a party to the compact

compact_privilege_jurisprudence_requirem.quote: "Jurisprudence Requirement" means an assessment of an individual's knowledge of the State laws and regulations governing the Practice of Dietetics in such State.

protected_titles.quote: No person shall use the title "dietitian"; (2) No person except for a person licensed under Title XLVII of the Revised Code, when acting within the scope of their practice, shall use any other title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, or insignia or combination of any title, designation, words, letters, abbreviation, or insignia tending to indicate that the person is practicing dietetics.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: An individual who holds a current, valid license issued under this chapter to practice dietetics and who retires voluntarily from practice may request that the state medical board place the individual's license on retired status.

ethics_code_violation_grounds_for_discip.quote: Standards of professional responsibility and practice for persons licensed under this chapter that are consistent with those standards of professional responsibility and practice adopted by the academy of nutrition and dietetics
